intent: Slightly shifted the 7 sensors laterally within ±0.01 m to optimize line coverage and reduce line loss events, increased wheel track to 0.17 m to improve stability and reduce steering oscillation, and reduced mass to 0.65 kg to enhance acceleration and completion rates. Expect fewer line loss events, lower rms error, smoother steering, and better finish rates, particularly on the slalom track where previous attempts failed to finish.
rationale: Iteration 4's 7-sensor symmetric array with 0.016 m sensor size and 0.16 m wheel track improved lateral coverage and reduced line loss events but still failed to finish the slalom track, with moderate steering oscillation and high control effort. The integrator feedback suggests trying slight lateral shifts of sensor positions within ±0.01 m to optimize coverage and potentially reduce line loss further. Additionally, increasing the wheel track slightly to 0.17 m may help reduce steering oscillation and improve stability, as wider tracks have correlated with better stability in prior iterations. Since progress and completion rates remain low, reducing mass to 0.65 kg could improve acceleration and finish rates. Therefore, I propose maintaining the 7-sensor layout and sensor size, applying small lateral position adjustments within ±0.01 m, increasing wheel track to 0.17 m, and reducing mass to 0.65 kg. I expect these changes to reduce line loss events, lower rms error, decrease steering oscillation, and improve completion rates, especially on the challenging slalom track.
